component.name: Telephony
component.summary: A native GTK4 dialer for Phosh

description.p: Telephony is a lightweight, mobile-friendly dialer designed for Linux phones. It uses the oFono backend to manage calls and provides seamless integration with system contacts.

ul.li: Smart dialpad with cursor support and paste validation
Call history with filtering by date, type, and duration
Background monitoring for sms and mms
Blocklist for calls, mms and sms

description.p: This is bugfixes only release + translates.
